Associate QA Engineer – Software at Light & Wonder, Bengaluru – Join the Gaming Quality Team

Job Overview

  • Light & Wonder is hiring an Associate QA Engineer to ensure software quality for its gaming products in Bengaluru.
  • The role involves rigorous testing, bug identification, and collaboration with development teams.

Responsibilities

  • Verify that all software functions as intended through detailed, systematic testing.
  • Act as the first line of defense in detecting and documenting functionality issues in games.
  • Review bugs, test cases, and create documentation using standard QA processes.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute test plans and scripts for new and existing game themes and features.
  • Track and update issue status in the bug‑tracking database (JIRA) until resolution.
  • Validate live game events to confirm they match design specifications and operate correctly.
  • Use debugging, admin, and external tools to diagnose, reproduce, and identify problems.
  • When needed, reproduce issues to assist developers in fixing them.
  • Generate status reports, documentation, and low‑level reports for supervisors.
  • Quickly adjust priorities with minimal downtime.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 1–2 years of software testing experience.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize tasks efficiently.
  • Results‑oriented mindset with a positive attitude; comfortable in fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environments.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and unpredictable situations.
  • Proficiency in executing test scripts and reporting feature/game status through scripted and ad‑hoc tests.
  • Good knowledge of software testing methodologies and the product development lifecycle.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional team members.
  • Capability to meet tight deadlines and deliver precise, effective results.

About Light & Wonder

  • Light & Wonder combines diverse talent to solve familiar challenges in new ways.
  • The company emphasizes integrity, teamwork, and continuous improvement in the gambling and casino industry.

How to Verify / Apply

  • The posting is available on LinkedIn India (URL provided).
  • Candidates can apply directly through the LinkedIn job portal, ensuring their profile matches the listed qualifications.
